lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb4Sm4Ag8 (YbSmAg2) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ag centers have eight geometric neighbors (4 Sm, 4 Yb), while Sm and Yb centers each have eight Ag neighbors, all at 3.2085 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ag polyhedra, as well as corner and face sharing between Sm and Yb polyhedra.
